findings: Queued entry flag2 can be set even while active flag4 or a blend prevents dequeue.
Readiness marking occurs before blend/active guards; repeated evaluation is idempotent in these profiles.
Without advancing node time, qualifying entries can still change flags on first evaluation; freezing all state evaluation would differ from native behavior.
limits: Three repeated evaluations with unchanged node time model evaluation without time advance; not full native pause dispatch.
Dequeue, allocation/free, callbacks, blend weights and replacement branches are not exercised.
